extension.summary: Download your premiumize.me cloud files at full speed and play them locally
extension.description: Browse your premiumize.me cloud, download videos over several parallel connections, start watching while they download, and play them from local or USB storage. Downloads resume after restarts, and subtitles next to a video come along with it.
extension.disclaimer: Needs a premiumize.me account. Not made by or affiliated with premiumize.me.
extension.news: 1.0.10: If a download slows to under half its best speed for 45 seconds with no visible reason, it gets a fresh link from premiumize and reconnects, as a manual restart would. The progress window shows drive speed, data waiting to be saved and reconnects. 1.0.9: The speed test pauses running downloads during the test (and resumes them after), so they no longer skew its numbers. 1.0.8: Shorter file names in the progress window, so long release names no longer hide the reason line. 1.0.7: Settings > Downloads > Test drive speed: writes a test file for about 30 seconds and shows how fast the download drive really saves data (average and longest pause). 1.0.6: Optional speed limit (Settings > Downloads) for networks that struggle at full speed. The progress window keeps long names to one line so the reason line stays visible, and shows a steady connection count with how many are retrying. 1.0.5: Speed test advice keeps at least 4 connections (so a slow one can be replaced) and says when your line is the limit. 1.0.4: Fixes downloads freezing at 0 speed when one connection slowed to a crawl: an idle connection now takes over the slow piece. Shows why a download is slow or waiting (drive speed, connection limits, retries) in the progress window, the corner bar and Downloads. A drive write that hangs now stops the download with a clear message. 1.0.3: When no USB drive is visible, explains that a drive set up as "device storage" must be formatted as removable storage. 1.0.2: "Choose download folder..." now lists USB drives found directly on the device (Kodi's own folder browser often misses them on the Shield), shows free space and size, and accepts a typed path. 1.0.1: Selecting a cloud video now shows the Play now / Download only / Stream choice as a normal list before playback starts (it could be invisible before). Corrected the Shield permission path in messages. 1.0.0: first release
